what: Gumroad help documentation positions the platform against "a marketplace model," claiming lower fees, fewer hassles, and higher conversion rates for direct-to-customer selling.
verbatim_snippet: "Gumroad is an online platform that allows you to sell your products directly to your customers, without the hassles, high fees, and low conversion rates of a marketplace model."
notes: help.gumroad.com requires sign-in authentication for direct access. Content extracted from Google search index cache of this URL. Implicit comparison to marketplace platforms (e.g., Amazon, Etsy) without naming any specifically. Dimension: fees, conversion rates, operational friction.
